title: WWGlas — claimed by payload
description: DE · Manufacturing · WWGlas (Glaszentrum Weber + Wagener GmbH & Co. KG) is a German family-owned company founded in 1901, specializing in the production and supply of glass products for the construction industry. Its product portfolio includes energy-efficient insulating glass, solar control glass, soundproof glass, fire-resistant glass, safety glass, and decorative glass. WWGlas primarily serves customers in Germany
